scientific_question: Does the source-complete native-vector and batch-tree allocator repair make the phase-selective 55-local/5-global proxy executable through the pinned full-model TARGET_VERIFY consumer, and does its measured net component saving remain consistent with the 1.7026%-2.1688% whole-request source bound?

scope.baseline: Pinned full-model stock 50-local/10-global target-verification forward with the same inputs, allocator, graph mode, and cache lifecycle.
scope.candidate: The single source-bound phase-selective 55-local/5-global proxy using converted layers [11, 23, 35, 47, 59], native logical-slot vectors, and the batch tree allocator for proxy KV ownership.
scope.consumer: Pinned full Gemma forward through target logits, mirrored accepted-prefix move/free, and one post-accept stock decode.
scope.predicted_physical_change: Five target-verification global-attention modules become 1,024-token local-attention modules, reducing attention work and KV traffic while leaving prefill and ordinary decode on the stock path.

measurement.comparison: One contemporaneous alternating stock/candidate exact-shape component comparison after warmup.
required_correctness: All stock-path prefill and ordinary-decode outputs are unchanged.
Native request/depth rows and logical-slot vectors remain distinct through allocation, TARGET_VERIFY, accepted-prefix move/free, reuse, and post-accept decode.
Padded rows are inert; required outputs are finite and correctly shaped; no illegal access or allocator alias occurs.
Candidate execution reaches the full-model target-logit consumer.
measurement.decision: Retain the mechanism only if the corrected full-model component is interpretable, correctness-bearing, and net-positive. A nonpositive net result or any boundary/correctness failure closes this realization without endpoint promotion.

execution.owner: One bounded durable owner in this project may retain the claim across one ordinary pre-science integration repair only when the terminal and release margins still fit.

serial_bench_contract.release_condition: Release the bench warm with all experiment processes stopped and updated resident contents; do not drain or retire it.
